rule: Duración hasta ahora con since/for → Present Perfect.

wrong: I work with Python for three years.
right: I've been working with Python for three years.
rule: Llevo X haciendo → Present Perfect Continuous + for.

wrong: If you will send me the file, I'll review it.
right: If you send me the file, I'll review it.
rule: Nunca will después de if: if + presente.

wrong: When I will arrive, I'll call you.
right: When I arrive, I'll call you.
rule: Nunca will después de when: when + presente.

wrong: I want that you check the code.
right: I want you to check the code.

rule: Know es verbo de estado: no va en continuo.

wrong: I have been in London last year.
right: I was in London last year.

wrong: If I would have more time, I would help.
right: If I had more time, I would help.
rule: Hipotético: if + Simple Past, sin would tras if.
